correctness.rationale: The exact affine branch coefficients are given by the source map. Both forward-unstable inverse and backward-stable forward series have coefficients and first derivatives uniformly bounded and slopes bounded by rho<1 on compact parameter sets. The q-th derivative of the n-th increment is O((n+1)^q rho^(n-q)), hence every derivative series converges uniformly; dominated differentiation against the fixed symbolic MMEs proves C^r response. Parameter-free center coding and local holomorphic contraction establish the final claims. Exact rational finite checks support but do not replace the infinite proof.
